title: Batched Fourier observation output
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. Given three lists of $m$ sign vectors, the output is the length-$m$ list, in their original order, of rational restricted Fourier weight observations: at each position, use the first vector's coordinates outside $J$ and the second and third vectors' coordinates on $J$ to form two inputs, and evaluate $f$ at both.
hypotheses_covered: three input functions each provide $m$ sign vectors
